newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firm despite rate rise speculation.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firm despite rate rise speculation.

text.p: UK shares started firm on Monday, dogged by the threat of an interest rate rise later this week but led higher once again by the bank sector amid a fresh bout of bid talk and as Woolwich made a strong market debut.
The FTSE 100 index was up 7.2 points at 4,820.0 by 0737 GMT, with gainers in a five-to-two majority. Conglomerate Tomkins rose after coupling in-line results with a 100 million stg share buyback.
Dealers said the threat of higher rates had hung over shares for some time without much hampering the market's upward progress.
